title: Asesor extended fields in sales list and edit
description: Surface the four new asesor fields (telefono, calendario, linea_negocio, activo) in the existing SalesEdit and SalesList components. The sales section is admin/manager-only. Extend SalesInputs with the new fields. SalesList shows activo status and linea_negocio. The asesor_asignado display on LeadShow links to the asesor's profile via the sales resource.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/atomic-crm/sales/SalesInputs.tsx adds inputs for telefono (text), calendario (text/URL), linea_negocio (select: exclusiva|compartida), activo (boolean toggle)
src/components/atomic-crm/sales/SalesList.tsx adds columns for activo and linea_negocio
SalesEdit saves the four new fields via dataProvider.update on the 'sales' resource
The asesor_asignado field on LeadShow links to the corresponding sales record show page

non_functional_requirements.security: SalesEdit route restricted to admin/manager via canAccess check (existing pattern)
